notes: Three taḥwīl branches, each written with its own names; «جميعا» and «كلاهما» make the first two converge, and the third (منجاب) gives the full route to Ibn Masʿud
The first branch stops at «أبي، معاوية» and the second at «الأعمش», where the text stops writing names; no tail is extended for them (rule 3 gives none)
«واللفظ له» is an editor gloss and is left out
